bdd.scenario: Sign up: a visitor submits valid registration details
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When a visitor submits valid registration details
bdd.then: Then the identity provider accepts the details or displays its configured verification step
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Keycloak hosted account-registration flow and the configured Keycloak identity provider
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Sign up: a visitor submits invalid registration details
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When a visitor submits invalid registration details
bdd.then: Then field-level validation is shown and no account is created
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Keycloak hosted account-registration flow and the configured Keycloak identity provider
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Sign up: a visitor uses an email already registered
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When a visitor uses an email already registered
bdd.then: Then the provider displays its safe duplicate-account response
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Keycloak hosted account-registration flow and the configured Keycloak identity provider
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Sign up: a visitor submits mismatched password confirmation
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When a visitor submits mismatched password confirmation
bdd.then: Then password confirmation validation prevents submission
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Keycloak hosted account-registration flow and the configured Keycloak identity provider
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.
